def test_arange1(self):
        def fn(x):
            rng1 = torch.arange(8 * 8, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device).view(8, 8)
            rng2 = torch.arange(10, 18, device=x.device)
            tmp = x * rng1
            return tmp, tmp + rng2

        self.common(fn, (torch.randn(8, 8),))
